decisive_items: Although tumor markers were normal, the imaging findings were concerning for an ovarian neoplasm.
a large hypoechoic lesion in the right adnexa
a well-marginated thin-walled solid-cystic lesion measuring 16.1 × 7.9 × 8.1 cm in the abdominopelvic region
response.rationale: Imaging findings and clinical presentation suggest an ovarian neoplasm despite normal tumor markers.

rejected.why: Uterine fibroids are present but not the primary concern based on imaging findings.
Serology for filarial infection was negative.
Lymphedema is a symptom, not the primary diagnosis.
